services.name: Our Ceramic Classes
services.desc: Learn to design and make your own jewelry. Nicole Garcia of Mindful Metals, our resident silversmith will teach you many techniques to bend solder any metal. Currently we offer a variety of beginner and intermediate classes for all levels of artists to enjoy. Many classes are a single day, while our advanced classes tend to span over 2 days. Check back in with us as we expand to include casting and wax carving in 2026! Choose from sterling silver, brass or plated 14k gold ($25 up charge) wire and learn to cut, file and solder your own bangles. Bring your own shells or choose from our studio stock. Class fee includes the making of 2 bangles. Cut, file, stamp and size your own sterling silver
